items.title: Jason Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Cuica’s a problem. Cuica is [Marsalis accurately imitates the sound with his voice]. I just can’t – you got to get the right amount of friction on the fingers and the [t?] to get the different pitches. I just can’t do it.

ctx.x: Yeah, but are you learning these instruments, is what I’m asking?

Yes, that’s what I’m – at the rehearsals I would play the caixas and sordus – mostly caixa though, but sordus. I didn’t learn every single one. Cuica’s a problem. Cuica is [Marsalis accurately imitates the sound with his voice]. I just can’t – you got to get the
right amount of friction on the fingers and the [t?] to get the different pitches. I just can’t do it.
